lines.text: Look up a payment: reads from Stripe, changes nothing.
List a payment's refunds: reads from Stripe, changes nothing.
Refund a payment: moves money through Stripe. It pays out or charges.
Refund a payment: a Card's "Only for" can name which payment it acts on.
Refund a payment: counted in the currency Stripe reports.
Refund a payment: after each call, KIFF reads it back from Stripe to check the amount.
Refund a payment: when Stripe refuses it with 400, 402 or 404, the Card gets that room back. Stripe's docs say nothing happened then.
